不错的增量游戏，画风很独特
做得挺有想法的增量游戏，强化树之类的都很有感觉 就是屏幕经常很花，分明是设计优点的场景破坏变成了干扰项，武器种类变多了下面的武器CD栏还会挡视野，通关资源选错方向还可能导致前面关卡卡住后面畅通无阻（不确定 个别UI没有翻译，还有脉冲PULSE被翻译成“请按任意键继续”这种神秘机翻...
ui美术这一块做的非常有识别度 很好 整体流程设计也可以说是短平快 没有过多的反复刷取需求 好玩 好评
超好玩巨好玩，绝美的动效和画面，完美的打击感，合理的难度曲线，简直是沧海遗珠啊！都来玩，游戏时长大概4小时，但是绝对值得，而且很完整，打到结束也很有成就感的

爽！

Very enjoyable. Well paced. Didn't have to grind too much. Satisfying amount of destruction. 7 hours for all achievements.
love it
Incredibly stylistic and well done game, a must have for anyone who has that skill tree incremental itch
Great fun

I loved this. A quick and cheap incremental game. Easy going and not too demanding. Completed it with all achievements in about 5 hours. It has a fantastic art style. The enemies are simple but cool with a great array of weapons. I actually wish you could play it more but as soon as you complete it, there really is no reason to go back once everything's been unlocked

It's really bad for players with colorblindness, as there are so many different instances where red is next to green, and blue is next to purple. These are the classic traps for people with deuteranopia. The game does a very poor job providing other ways to distinguish enemies, since their unique shapes all just sort of blend together in peripheral vision when there are a lot of enemies on screen. I thought about contacting the developers for the sake of helping them address the issue and help them introduce proper colorblind support, but based on the discussion channels, they appear to no longer be responding to anyone, so it's not worth the effort.
nice Style, gameplay is fairly easy for the price its very good :)

4-5 hours of farming, but not bad. The weapon upgrades are pretty unique. A decent game at any indie price, but a fantastic game while on sale for ~$2.50. 4/5 - Definite buy if you enjoy these types of games.
Short sweet little tower game. It's not a tower defense, more like wave defense with a stationary tower. Good nonetheless. I got about 5 hours out of it with some AFK time in there adding to 6 hours
Really great game. thanks!!!
Great game. Good amount of content for the price and I've never seen so much polish go into a UI.
